**A new lid for tissue box covers that slides on like a battery cover and can't be levered off.** Print the cover again for it. The web version has it too: <https://rickusinggithub.github.io/vaseinator/>.

### Download & run (Windows)
1. Download **Vaseinator.exe** below and run it. It is one file: nothing to unzip or install. SHA256SUMS.txt holds its checksum.
2. The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.

No Python needed. To run from source on any OS, see the README. Or just use it in your browser: <https://rickusinggithub.github.io/vaseinator/>.

### Changed in 1.16.0
- **Why the old lid fell off.** Its tabs caught on ledges inside the cover's ends. But a thin cover wall is stiff only near its corners - the middle of an end bows out at a touch - and a ledge inside a cover printed upside down has to have a sloping face. So the weight of a box of tissues pushed the walls apart and the lid slipped off, however big the catch.
- **The new lid slides on.** The cover now has four short **rails** inside its long sides, by the corners, where the wall is stiff. The lid has four rigid **hooks** that never have to bend:
  - Lay the lid on the rim with its pull tab's end sticking out 8 mm, then **push it along till it clicks**. Each hook slides in behind its rail and wedges tighter as it comes home, so the lid is drawn tight against the rim, with no wiggle.
  - A **latch** by the pull tab - a flat spring, printed flat, the strong way - springs up inside the cover's end, so the lid can't slide back. A stop at the far end says it is home.
  - To change the tissues, **lift the tab a little and pull**: the lid slides back and lifts off.
  - A fence along each long side keeps the lid from sagging under the box of tissues.
- **Lid grip** (Gentle, Snug, Firm) now sets how tightly the hooks fit the rails: a step firmer if the lid is loose, a step gentler if it is hard to slide home.
- **Print the cover again.** A cover made before 1.16 has no rails, so the new lid won't hold on it. To try the fit first without a long print, set the box's **Tall** to 1.2 cm and print that short cover with its lid.
- Changes to covers: the rails replace the ledges inside the ends; the long sides have at least 4.6 mm of room inside for the hooks (the Tissue Box Cover is 1.2 mm wider); the rails' faces are straight even on a lumpy or ribbed cover; and rounded hole edges keep 8.5 mm clear of the rim.

Vaseinator is free. If it has made you something you like, you can [buy me a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rickapps).
